items.summary: In the Motoko backend (backend/main.mo), replace or update the isAdmin() / isCallerAdmin() function so that it hardcodes the caller's Principal ID as a permanent admin. Add the user's Principal to an `adminPrincipals` array (or equivalent structure) and ensure the function returns `true` when `msg.caller` matches any entry in that array. Remove or bypass any other admin validation logic (e.g., token-based checks, registry lookups) that currently blocks the admin check from succeeding.

In the Motoko backend, ensure the `createCollection` (or equivalent collection-creation) function logs / exposes `msg.caller` in its response or error so that the admin Principal can be confirmed at runtime. If the function throws an authorization error, it must only do so when `isAdmin(msg.caller)` returns `false`; with the hardcoded Principal it must succeed and return the new collection.

Update the frontend `useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout` hook and any related admin-check hooks so that the hardcoded admin Principal used on the frontend matches the one now hardcoded in the backend. Ensure the admin navigation link and admin dashboard are immediately accessible for the hardcoded admin without requiring a backend round-trip timeout fallback.
